producer_report.summary: Added `athena-core::ci_result`, a pure module that applies the 5.3 rules to a CI result keyed by commit SHA, with a local fallback. The platform read and the local run are injected, so the tests need no network. A run for another SHA is ignored. A missing, unfinished (after a bounded wait), cancelled, skipped or timed-out run, an unreachable service, or a green run with a `.github/workflows/` file changed runs the three checks locally once and records them as local. A red run for the SHA is a failure and the fallback does not run. If neither source gives all three checks, the outcome is blocked with a named reason. `gh.rs` reads the `ci` run for a SHA from the platform API, `checks::runs_from_record` turns a record into check records, and `verify::reuse_statement` builds the line for the verifier's input (only when the SHA matches). Item 4 in the design doc is marked "built in part" with what remains. The CHANGELOG has an entry. Nothing is claimed about speedup. The new code is not yet called from a real job run, which the doc and changelog say.

checks_run.note: Applied formatting. I did not run `cargo fmt --all --check` separately afterwards.

The full run printed no failure and the tool reported no error, but its output was truncated and I could not search it. I confirmed separately that `cargo test --locked -p athena-core ci_result` runs and passes all 15 ci_result tests. The new gh, checks and verify tests ran only inside the full run.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: new tests pass showing a CI result whose SHA differs from the candidate's is ignored (stale) and never yields a verified outcome; each test fails if the SHA comparison is removed.
criteria_check.evidence: The ci_result tests `a_green_run_for_another_sha_is_stale_and_never_verifies`, `a_stale_run_is_ignored_and_the_local_record_is_used` and `a_red_run_for_another_sha_is_not_this_candidates_failure` pass. Each would fail without the `run.sha != sha` check in `read_ci`. I did not remove the check to confirm.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: tests show a missing, unfinished, cancelled, skipped or timed-out CI result selects the local fallback, which runs the three checks once and records them as local, keyed by SHA.
criteria_check.evidence: `no_unfinished_cancelled_skipped_or_timed_out_run_selects_the_local_fallback` covers no run, unfinished, cancelled, skipped, timed out and service error. It asserts source Local, the candidate SHA, and exactly one local call.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: a red CI result for the matching SHA is a failed check and the fallback is not run to hide it; a green run with a workflow file changed in the same candidate is not trusted and falls back locally.
criteria_check.evidence: `a_red_run_for_the_same_sha_fails_and_the_fallback_does_not_hide_it` asserts Failed and zero local calls. `a_green_run_with_a_workflow_file_changed_is_not_trusted` asserts a Local record and one local call.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: when neither CI nor the local run can produce a result, the outcome is blocked with a named reason, not verified (no empty success).
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.
criteria_check.evidence: Clippy ran clean. `cargo fmt --all` was applied after the last edit; I did not rerun it with `--check`.

criteria_check.criterion: The record holds the run address, full SHA, per-step conclusions and duration, and Athena (not the verifier) is what reads it; the verifier command set in athena.toml is unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: `CiRecord` has `run_address`, `sha`, `steps` and `duration_s`. `the_record_round_trips_with_its_address_sha_steps_and_duration` covers it. The platform read lives in `gh.rs`, which Athena runs. athena.toml is untouched.

open_issues: `resolve`, `runs_from_record` and `reuse_statement` are not called from `run.rs` or the verifier input path. `run.rs` is not in the deliverables. The record is not yet used by a real job.
The candidate is not pushed before the CI read. The wait bound has no real value yet; it needs section 9 data.
The CI workflow runs the three checks as one step, so per-check conclusions and times are approximated.
mistakes: I could not read the full `cargo test --locked` output because it was truncated. I judged the full run passed from the absence of an error, plus a targeted run of the ci_result tests.
learnings: CI has one step, `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- ci`, that runs fmt, clippy and test together. The platform gives one conclusion for all three and no per-check time. `gh::parse_ci_run` gives that conclusion to each check and sets each check's time to 0.
`GhClient::api` retries transient failures and records host errors; the new fetch reuses it.
The Bash tool refuses pipes and `grep`, and the Grep tool refuses paths outside the working directory. Large cargo output saved by the tool cannot be searched.
desires: A way to read saved large tool output, or a cargo test summary flag, to confirm the full test result.
